excerpt.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的细缝发生了失稳，打开了一道通往其他时空的裂隙。

我们应当小心应对。
excerpt.en:
The dimensional scar in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system has destabilized, opening a rift into another place and time.

We should approach with caution.

texts.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的细缝发生了失稳，打开了一道通往其他时空的裂隙。

我们应当小心应对。
texts.en:
The dimensional scar in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system has destabilized, opening a rift into another place and time.

We should approach with caution.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系发现了一处特别的时空裂隙。也许我们花时间研究一些其特质就可以找到进一步探索的方式。
texts.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties we can find a way to explore further.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一处令人惊奇的时空裂隙。如果花时间研究其性质，我们或许能找到进一步探索的方式。我们无从得知里面究竟有什么。
texts.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

texts.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
texts.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

sections.zh: 我们发现了一处令人惊奇的时空裂隙。如果花时间研究其性质，我们或许能找到进一步探索的方式。我们无从得知里面究竟有什么。
sections.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

sections.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
sections.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

texts.zh:
在研究[target.solar_system.GetName]中的星界裂隙时，我们不可避免地扰动了这个维度异常，造成了严重的时空扭曲，让附近的现实以不可预知的方式发生了歪斜。

一颗我们称为[planet_rift_in_space.GetName]的神秘行星突然无中生有般出现。我们任何一张星图中都没有其此前存在的记载。

其上承载着一个[GetPreFTLLower]文明。

我们只能推测它是通过某种方式来自我们宇宙之外的地方。
texts.en:
While studying the Astral Rift in [target.solar_system.GetName], we have inadvertently destabilized the dimensional anomaly. This is causing violent distortions in space and time, bending nearby reality in an unpredictable manner.

A mysterious planet, which we are calling [planet_rift_in_space.GetName], has appeared where before there was nothing. We have no records of its previous existence on any of our star charts.

It is populated by a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization.

Our best guess is that it somehow arrived from outside of our universe.

texts.zh:
在研究[target.solar_system.GetName]中的星界裂隙时，我们不可避免地扰动了这个维度异常，造成了严重的时空扭曲，让附近的现实以不可预知的方式发生了歪斜。

在[rift_temporary_species_planet.GetName]凭空出现了一个感性物种，均匀地与我们现存的人口混居着。

[rift_temporary_species.GetName]并没有关于他们来自何方的记忆，且没有表现出任何敌意。

无论他们来自哪里，看来我们都没有办法帮他们回家了。
texts.en:
While studying the Astral Rift in [target.solar_system.GetName], we have inadvertently destabilized the dimensional anomaly. This is causing violent distortions in space and time, bending nearby reality in an unpredictable manner.

A new sentient species has materialized on [rift_temporary_species_planet.GetName], distributed evenly across our existing population.

The [rift_temporary_species.GetName] have no memory of where they are from and do not appear hostile.

Wherever they originated, it is unlikely we can help them return.

texts.zh:
在研究[target.solar_system.GetName]中的星界裂隙时，我们不可避免地扰动了这个维度异常，造成了严重的时空扭曲，让附近的现实以不可预知的方式发生了歪斜。

[rift_temporary_planet.GetName]上严重的扭曲导致时间以两倍速流逝。我们需要密切关注这一局势，确保翻倍供应补给。
texts.en:
While studying the Astral Rift in [target.solar_system.GetName], we have inadvertently destabilized the dimensional anomaly. This is causing violent distortions in space and time, bending nearby reality in an unpredictable manner.

Significant temporal distortions on [rift_temporary_planet.GetName] are causing time to pass twice as quickly. We should monitor the situation closely, and make sure to double their supplies.

texts.zh:
我们发现，想要钻进时空的折缝中需要完美光滑的船体。

只要分配足够的研究资源和时间，我们确信自己能研发这种装置，并可以暂时将其命名为“裂隙探球”。然后我们就有可能发现这个空间异常背后的秘密。
texts.en:
We have discovered that slipping through the folds in space and time requires a perfectly smooth vessel.

We are certain that we can develop such a device, what we are tentatively calling a "Rift Sphere", should we devote enough research and time. We may then finally discover what is beyond this spatial anomaly.
